description: Video chapters from transcript — Turns a timestamped transcript (00:01:23 lines, [mm:ss] lines, SRT or VTT via transcript= or url=) into YouTube-ready chapters with titles and one-line summaries. Chapter starts are snapped to real transcript timestamps, the first is forced to 00:00 and chapters under 10 seconds are merged. Optional count=, language=, style=; untimed text works with duration= seconds. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
